title: Remove WatchGod
description:
WatchGod's last release was in April 1st 2022 (https://pypi.org/project/watchgod/).

The repository was renamed to [WatchFIles](https://github.com/samuelcolvin/watchfiles), and a new package with that name was created there - which we support as one of the reload classes here in Uvicorn.

After more than 2 years and a half being deprecated, I think it's time to say goodbye.
